purpose: Synthetic metric definitions for downstream deterministic implementations; not executable configuration for this MCP engine.

metrics.duplicate_policy: Reject duplicate business keys unless an approved revision rule resolves them.
metrics.commitment_policy: Exclude commitments already represented by actual spend.
metrics.source_requirement: All included inputs must be approved for the requested scope; partial evidence permits only a labelled subtotal.

metrics.aggregation_policy: Aggregate numerators and denominators; do not average per-record ratios.
metrics.interpretation_limit: Historical association only; no causal or future-performance claim.
